name: Nordheide Wind Park (synthetic example)
description: Construction and operation of a wind farm with 8 wind turbines, each with a total height of 200 m and a capacity of 5.6 MW (44.8 MW in total). Works include access road construction, foundation excavation, crane pads, underground cabling and a grid connection substation. Construction duration is 14 months. Heavy transport deliveries of turbine components are required.
environmental_setting: Arable farmland with hedgerows; a woodland edge 400 m to the east used by bats; the nearest residential buildings are 900 m away. A Natura 2000 site is located approximately 3 km to the north.
